name: Ningen Fushin no Renkinjutsushi to Moto Heishi no Homunculus
original_name: 人間不信の錬金術師と元兵士のホムンクルス
source:
Two alchemists, who shared the same dreams and aspirations, formed a strong bond. They spent their lives doing research, hoping that one day they can enrich people's lives and make the world full of happiness. After several years, they finally gave birth to a new creation: A homunculus that can live outside of a flask.

The alchemist who started the research was delighted to know that their creation will be a better partner for humans and make them happy. However, he learned that his own partner and only friend had proposed the king to use the homunculi as weapons, and the government accepted, giving him a large sum of money and a position in the service of the royal family.

― "If we use the homunculi in the war, we can reduce a lot of casualties, and if we can expand our territory, our lives will be enriched! This is the most effective way to use our homunculus, it'll make everyone happy!"

Feeling angry and betrayed, the alchemist denounced his friend and appealed directly to the king to prevent the use of the homunculi in the war. However, he was stripped of his position and was banished from the royal capital.

Several years had passed since then. 

Even though he heard rumors that the war was over, the alchemist is still unable to heal his emotional wounds, and spends his days living in apathy. Until one day, when he went to a landfill in the forest and found an abandoned "sack" containing a "girl."

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1191196&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
兩名鍊金術師有著相同的夢想和志向，也結下了深厚的情誼。他們把人生投入研究，希望有朝一日能改善人們的生活，讓世上多一點幸福。數年之後，他們終於創造出了一種新生命：能夠離開燒瓶獨立生存的人造人。

最初發起研究的鍊金術師十分高興。他相信，這些造物會成為人類的好夥伴，給人帶來幸福。不料，自己的研究搭檔，也是唯一的朋友，竟向國王建議把人造人當作武器。王國不僅採納了建議，還賜給他一大筆錢，讓他在王室身邊任職。

「讓人造人去打仗，就能少死許多人。若能開拓疆土，我們的生活還會更富足！這才是人造人最有效的用途，人人都會得到幸福！」

鍊金術師又驚又怒，深感背叛。他斥責朋友，直接向國王進言，請求阻止人造人被用於戰爭。換來的卻是被剝奪地位，流放出王都。

幾年過去了。

雖然聽說戰爭已經結束，他心裡的傷仍未癒合，只是漫不經心地打發著日子。直到某天，他來到森林裡的垃圾場，發現了一個被丟棄的「袋子」。裡頭裝著一名「少女」。
